name: mcp-events-bridge
description: Watch MCP Events bridge events (GitHub, Resend, webhooks) in the background: Claude is told as each one happens, between prompts too.

mcp_url.title: Bridge MCP endpoint
mcp_url.description: Your bridge's MCP endpoint, https://<bridge>/mcp (or http://127.0.0.1:8080/mcp for a local bridge). The older form with the secret in it, /mcp/<BRIDGE_MCP_SECRET>, still works.

mcp_secret.title: Bridge MCP secret
mcp_secret.description: BRIDGE_MCP_SECRET from the bridge's .env (or its Fly secrets), sent as Authorization: Bearer. Leave it empty only if the endpoint above has the secret in it.
